item.title: Barrier on Debian Bookworm"
item.author: paul@insightsforaction.uk (Paul Hewson)
item.description:
From Pexels Andrea Plaquadeo

I’m using barrier to share my mouse between my laptop and desktop. They are both now running Debian Bookworm, and it means when I have a slow job running on one machine (as I write this I’m trying to compute a huge distance matrix of phonetic matches to car models in the MOT database).
